newsitem.title: CROATIA: Tudjman takes break to check on health.
newsitem.headline: Tudjman takes break to check on health.

text.p: Croatian president Franjo Tudjman has taken a short break for a "regular medical check-up", the state-run HINA news agency reported on Wednesday.
A spokesman for the president's office, Tihomir Vinkovc, said he "had nothing to add" to the HINA report. He declined to say how long the break would be or where the check-up was taking place.
It is the first time any medical checks for Tudjman have been officially announced.
The non-smoking 74-year-old leader maintains a public image of robust health and is occasionaly seen on television playing tennis.
